newsitem.title: INDIA: India to seek Bangladesh, Bhutan help on militants.
newsitem.headline: India to seek Bangladesh, Bhutan help on militants.

text.p: India will seek the help of Bhutan and Bangladesh to flush out separatist militants in its troubled northeastern states, the Press Trust of India (PTI) news agency said on Wednesday.

It quoted Indian Interior Minister Indrajit Gupta as telling an all-party delegation from the northeastern state of Assam that New Delhi had discussed the issue of illegal "sanctuaries" with the two neighbours.
New Delhi says separatist tribal and Maoist groups operating in its seven remote states often seek sanctuary in the border regions of the two neighbouring countries.
